column1: 1. Enter your budget numbers in the monthly columns (Year 1) and annual columns (Years 2-5).
2. To add WebClerk actuals: export GL journals (Generic CSV), paste amounts into the Actuals row below each category.
3. Formulas auto-calculate totals, gross margin, net income, and margin percentages.
4. Balance Sheet is annual. Retained Earnings should tie to cumulative Net Income.
5. Save your version. Upload improvements to webclerk.com/library/ for the community.
